verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Phaser runs in-browser via npm/CDN install with reasonable payload options (docs-1/3/20/22) and community reports confirm actual WebGL (and Canvas) rendering in production use (phaser-comm-11, phaser-comm-17 citing 60fps exports). However, the evidence pack contains no mention of WebGPU support, a WebGPU renderer, or any roadmap/story for WebGPU adoption, so the 'credible WebGPU story' half of the claim is entirely unevidenced. Missing for 10: any documentation or community confirmation of WebGPU renderer support, WebGPU performance benchmarks, or a stated WebGPU roadmap.
